title: Brand impact walls

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Give a retail space distinct visual anchors so visitors can orient themselves before approaching a demonstration.
strategic_value: Large household scenes can make a Cox showroom feel connected to domestic use while product zones remain identifiable.
demonstration: A panoramic store rendering places large lifestyle imagery on perimeter walls around low product fixtures and a central Contour station.
practical_value: Compare the scale of distant wall imagery with nearby product signage to establish a useful hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Perimeter imagery
content_islands.spec: Use broad photographic panels along the left and right walls.

content_islands.name: Product floor
content_islands.spec: Keep low display tables and the Contour station in the center, leaving sightlines to the wall graphics.
